title: LlamaIndex Debuts OpenDocRouter API to Switch OCR Models
summary:
The newly released platform provides a single interface to access various frontier and open-weight models for document transcription. LlamaIndex launched OpenDocRouter to allow developers to change parsing models in a single line of code without rewriting prompts or creating new integrations. The service debuts with 10 models, including GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, with pricing between $0.86 and $48.82 per 1,000 pages and a minimum account top up of $25.

OpenDocRouter integrates ParseBench to provide quality and cost benchmarks for users navigating approximately 4,000 OCR models on Hugging Face. LlamaIndex offers the underlying models at cost plus a small transaction fee and adds grounding capabilities, such as bounding boxes, for models that do not natively support them. The company is currently developing automated routing for the API.

selectedTweets.text:
Today we're announcing OpenDocRouter: every model for document parsing under one API.

There are ~4,000 OCR models on Hugging Face, and the frontier labs ship a new one nearly every month. Whatever's best for your docs today won't be by Q1.

So stop asking which model to use for doc parsing. Ask how fast you can switch.

✅ Switch models in one line: same request, same markdown output, no new prompts or integrations
✅ Any model you want: 10 frontier and open-source models at launch, including Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6 Luna, MinerU2.5-Pro and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6
✅ Choose with receipts: every model scored on ParseBench for quality and cost
✅ Traceable output from any model: "layout: true" adds grounded bounding boxes and the same layout classes, even for models that don't support it natively
✅ Pay only for what works: per-token pricing, failed pages never charged, top up from $25

The spread is the point: $0.86 to $48.82 per 1,000 pages, depending on what your documents actually need.

Live now → https://t.co/sXXygu3fPL

selectedTweets.text:
Today I’m excited to introduce OpenDocRouter - a unified API for document parsing with the latest frontier and open-weight models.

There are a lot of VLMs and OCR models that can be used for document parsing: we have over 130+ models on ParseBench, and a HuggingFace search for “ocr” turns up thousands of results.

It’s extremely time consuming to choose between OCR vendors. You need to figure out the right prompts, handle rate limits, manage deployments, integrations with all models you’re using, and benchmark new models as they come out.

OpenDocRouter provides a comprehensive, transparent set of models along the price-performance frontier. It manages a unified API to transcribe documents to markdown. It serves all frontier and open-weight models “at-cost”, with a small transaction cut. It handles rate limits with all models to ensure you can put massive volume through. It even offers bounding boxes and layout as a service, so that you can add grounding to any model that you’re using.

When new OCR candidate models ship, we will benchmark them on ParseBench and immediately add them to OpenDocRouter. 

We’re adding a lot more models very quickly, and also adding some extremely exciting feature improvements (e.g. automated routing) as we speak.

We welcome your feedback!

Check it out: https://t.co/v8PieWWUNV

Blog: https://t.co/ilVqqJRacP

OpenDocRouter is here!
https://t.co/2KAGTxw26N

Some time ago, I realized LlamaIndex was really good at benchmarking and applying nearly every model to document parsing (see: ParseBench). So, why not make that its own platform?

Simple token-based pricing, broad model access, and continuous benchmarking, baked into one app. Try it out today!
